raw_response:
This small plot near my compound, only 0.05 hectares, I use for yam and some cassava mixed together. I have some money from my bigger plots so I can buy a small bag of NPK to help the yams, but not too much because the soil here still has life from the manure my goats drop. I will use the yam setts I saved from last harvest — the local variety does well here and I trust it. My wife and children will help me with the mounding and weeding, but for making the big yam heaps I will call two or three young men from the village to help for a few days.
